in_latin.name: Cyrien
in_latin.meaning: Christian name originating from Greek Σκιρενλοσ
in_latin.long_meaning: Cyrien, a name derived from the Greek word Σκιρενλοσ, meaning 'Cyrian' or 'of the people of Cyrene'. In early Christian tradition, the name Cyrien was associated with Saint Cyriacus, a 4th-century martyr and saint. The name has since been used in various Christian cultures to signify a connection to the saint or the region of Cyrene, in modern-day Libya.
